description: Check a request sent with create_request, by the ref it returned. Returns the status ('new' waiting for the business, 'confirmed', 'declined', 'cancelled', 'pending' waiting up to 24 hours, or 'not_available' if it expired), the time booked, the order total, the price for quotes, the business's note, and once confirmed how the customer pays the business. Use it to tell the customer whether the business confirmed. To cancel, use cancel_request. Read-only and safe to repeat; poll at most once a minute. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).
name: get_request_status
title: Check a request status
